name: suede
description: Open-source AI skills for SEO, marketing, and business operations in Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: suede-skills
plugins.description: Open-source AI skills for SEO, marketing, and business operations in Claude Code and Codex. Installs the complete pack, including code review, app delivery, and creator workflows.

plugins.name: suede-agent-workflows
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration subset: search competing plans and ship one selected repo change through the Suede Thought Graph DAG (suede-graph-flo-xr), coordinate build lanes with quality gates and a signed handoff (suede-agent-teams), route cross-surface work end to end (suede-workflow-skills), and turn AI features into eval specs and acceptance gates (suede-ai-eval).

plugins.name: suede-code
plugins.description: Code quality subset: one-pass review plus an A-F ship verdict (suede-code), deep findings with TypeScript, React, Next.js, OWASP, and database checklists (suede-code-review), a grade-only verdict with instant-F triggers and grade caps (suede-code-grader), and CI branch protection that gates the merge (suede-ci-gate).

plugins.name: suede-marketing
plugins.description: Suede marketing and growth subset: paid acquisition and outbound, monetisation (pricing, offers, paywalls), lifecycle and retention, and the measurement and operations layer. Licensed source acknowledgements remain at repository level.
